Name: Witchy-Gothic Craftables (unofficial conversion)
Author: a4kil
Description:
Made an unofficial version of Craftables from the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/420?tab=files]Witchy-Gothic buildings 1.1 UPDATE[/url]" for CP and AT.
Thank you so much to [url=https://holy-the-sea.github.io/stardew-cp-content-pack-builder/]this site[/url].

[b]Notes:[/b]
— To my surprise, it turns out that the Skeleton model and Singing Stoneare available in both Craftables and Furniture. That's why they have two options. I may have wasted my time, but let it be.
— I have no idea what to do with the pictures, the sofa and the two chairs. I have a suspicion it's from another mod, but which one? I don't know.
